# `^GD` – Graphic Diagonal Line

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Produces a straight diagonal line on a label within a bounding box defined by width and height. Can be used with other graphic commands to create complex figures.

Reference parameters: **w, h, t, c, o**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 213](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
